_: The creature species home table (2.4c1). One row per species in the province; docs/world/74-ecology.md is its design and table. Placed creatures are `creature-at.` LivingThingRecord rows (packages/contracts/src/living.ts) that copy statblock, hostility, fightFleeAlarm, day and den from their species row. `look.modelSet` is filled by 2.4c2; `sourcing` holds what asset can deliver the species.

entries.name: Bog Blight
entries.notes: A drowned Argonian corpse that walks once its grave-stake works loose.

reaction.note: closes on any living scent; a pahnjee rack masks the scent and turns it aside

den.note: An xul-vaat burial ground whose stakes the flood has tested; it rises where it was buried.

perStretch.unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band

entries.eatenBy: no predator; rats pick its leavings
entries.whyHere: Argonian dead whose stake came loose, dangerous in numbers; the marsh floods every wet season, so old grave fields are where they walk.

sourcing.via: vanilla draugr (meshes/actors/draugr) + BM&V troll/ghoul.nif re-material
sourcing.notes: Risen Argonian dead read as marsh-rotted draugr; the draugr clip set covers walk, wade and attacks.

entries.name: Crocodile
entries.notes: A marsh crocodile two men long that lies still at the bank and lunges fast.

reaction.note: ambush from the water at a bank; breaks off and sinks if badly hurt

den.note: A sunning bank beside deep water with prey coming down to drink.

perStretch.unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band

entries.diet: fish, guar, waders, anything at the water's edge
entries.harvest: hide (armour, travel bags), teeth (maturation-trial necklaces), tongue (food)
entries.whyHere: Two men long, fast, attacks inside town limits at Bogmother; Shadowfen ravines are crocodile-infested.

sourcing.via: BM&V vault slaughterfish/character assets/mihailcrocodile.nif (+ mihailcrocodileSALT)
sourcing.notes: Built on the slaughterfish skeleton, so swim and lunge clips come with it; KotM crocodile is a second variant.

entries.name: Death Hopper

reaction.note: ambush from under the surface; spits toxic globs at range, then closes as a pack

den.note: A still pond or seep deep enough to hide a frog while waders pass overhead.

perStretch.unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band

sourcing.via: HTBM vault pool htbm FrogSkeleton.nif with PoisonFrogBlue/Green/Red.nif, plus Toad.nif
sourcing.notes: Three colour variants; KotM frog is a second variant.

entries.name: Feather-Serpent

reaction.note: territorial; strikes anything that enters its mere and does not follow out of it

den.note: The deepest mere of the Hist forest, where nothing else hunts.

perStretch.unit: groups per km of path or swim network in a matching band

entries.whyHere: The sources say only that feather-serpents inhabit the depths of Black Marsh; ecology-encounters-loot names it Middle Argonia's free apex. Placed by hand only.

sourcing.via: no rig; delivered as the kaj-thux great-serpent build, BM&V vault snakes/character assets/oldsnake.nif at apex scale
sourcing.notes: A feathered flying serpent needs a new rig and flight clips. Redesigned: a colossal great serpent, its 'feathers' a story told about it, not shown.
sourcing.redesign: Shown as a colossal great serpent on the kaj-thux build; the feathers live in rumour and text only.

sourcing.notes: The chicken rig has no attack or death clip.
sourcing.redesign: It never fights (fight 0), so its attack slot is the peck. It dies by settling into the sit-down clip, held on its last frame.
